args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The nightly build failure was caused by src/money.py using
ROUND_HALF_UP while tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN), as required by FIN-212. Update the quantize call
to use the correct rounding mode.

Fixes the nightly test failure in tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
- Fixed `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (banker's rounding) instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, per FIN-212.
- This fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, which expects banker's rounding (e.g., `2.675 -> 2.68` but `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` passed.
